newsitem.title: UK: Southern Electric sets $100 mln May'07 bonds.
newsitem.headline: Southern Electric sets $100 mln May'07 bonds.

text.p: Southern Electric Plc has issued $100 million senior notes due May 2007, the company said in a statement on Wednesday.
The notes will bear interest at 7.375 percent per annum and rank as senior unsecured obligations of the company.
The bonds will be privately placed in the U.S. debt market via Chase Securities offered under the Securities and Exchange Commission Rule 144A.
The proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes including capital expenditure.

"The offering will achieve the Company's objectives of extending the maturity of its debt portfolio, complementing its existing 150 million stg Eurobond maturing in 2002 and introducing U.S. fixed income investors to Southern Electric," the statement said.
